method: Each published row is compared field by field (date, start time, event number, event name, buy-in, structure-sheet link) with the official document that prints it. A missing row, a moved start time or a different buy-in is a contradiction, not a warning. A row whose series has no readable official document is reported as skipped so the coverage figure stays honest.
